Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer asserted that the rhyme had Roud number 841 based on a search snippet without verifying an authoritative source. The correct Roud Folk Song Index for the nursery rhyme “What Are Little Boys Made Of?” (and its “little girls” variant inspiring the title) is 821, not 841. This incorrect claim led the Planner to finalize the wrong answer.
